segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Good morning to our colleagues in government, our resource persons, and everyone present today.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Today, we deliberate on the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of Public Works and Highways,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: one of the government's most important implementing agencies.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: The DPWH plays a crucial role not only in building roads, bridges, flood control systems,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Infrastructure spending has a significant multiplier effect on the economy,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: creating jobs, improving connectivity, attracting investments, and stimulating economic activity.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: As demonstrated by developed countries, infrastructure deserves as the backbone of a strong economy,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: opening up opportunities, and ultimately improving the quality of lives of our people.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: DEPDev reported that infrastructure spending averaged around 5.8% of GDP from 2022 to 2024,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: but dropped significantly to around 4.7% in 2025.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And at present, 2026 is much even worse.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: underspending and delays in project implementation as risks to achieving our growth targets.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: This comes amid a sharp 32.2% contraction in public construction for the first half of 2026,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: raising serious concerns about the pace of infrastructure development and its impact on economic growth.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Noong nakaraang taon, naging sentro ng kontrobersya ang DPWH dahil sa mga anomalya sa flood control projects.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: It is one of, if not the largest, corruption scandal in the history of our country.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Noong sumalbulat po ito, mistulang tumigil ang lahat, at nauunawaan po natin ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: The flood control corruption scandal should be treated as a temporary speed bump.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
